units.reason: Stale compaction now runs through a shared helper with a new head view, eviction watermark and block time bounds.
units.headline: Stale head compaction delegates to shared compactHeadViewLocked with appendID watermark
units.summary: CompactStaleHead now builds blocks from NewSelectedSeriesHead instead of NewStaleHead via compactHeadViewLocked, which allocates a fresh BlockMeta per chunk range, skips empty writes, and evicts only series without samples above the committed appendID watermark. This changes which series are evicted and the block bounds (view.Meta().MaxTime+1 instead of BlockMaxTime()), so it affects what is persisted versus kept in the head.
focus: NewSelectedSeriesHead with stale refs yields the same series/time bounds as the old NewStaleHead (view.Meta().MaxTime+1 vs BlockMaxTime())
truncateStaleSeries with the committedAppendID watermark keeps series that got samples during the block write
Series that became non-stale between ref collection and write end up both in a stale-tagged block and the head; confirm overlap is handled
Metrics/log at the end only run on success, failure counting still happens in the deferred handler

units.reason: Changes which blocks drive the in-order maxt used for head truncation and WAL-replay cutoff.
units.headline: inOrderBlocksMaxTime ignores blocks tagged from-selected-series
units.summary: Blocks carrying the new from-selected-series hint no longer count toward the in-order block max time, mirroring stale and out-of-order blocks. This prevents a partial-view block from advancing the head truncation/WAL-replay cutoff past WAL-only data of other series.
focus: All callers of inOrderBlocksMaxTime (reload head truncation, WAL replay) tolerate ok=false when only selected-series blocks exist
Hint is preserved through compaction (CompactBlockMetas / plan segregation) so merged selected blocks stay excluded

units.reason: Two tests are deleted here but re-added later in the file with identical assertions, so coverage is unchanged.
units.headline: Stale and OOO hint merge tests moved further down db_test.go
units.summary: TestStaleBlockNotMergedWithNonStaleBlock and TestOutOfOrderBlockMergePreservesHint are removed at this position and re-added verbatim (plus an extra comment paragraph) later in the same file. No assertion is dropped, so a line-by-line review is unnecessary beyond confirming the move.
